xmldoc.short_description: Opens a list selection dialog box.

param_input_item.param_description: Required list entries. Use a cell array of character vectors or a string array.

param_output_item.param_description: Row vector of selected one-based indices. Empty when canceled.

description.p: listdlg displays selectable text entries and returns the selected indices.

example_item.example_item_description: Preview a list selection dialog layout.
Select several entries from a list.
